heading_chain.markdown: ## 28.5 已知有限模型的最粗稳定分割算法

proof_markers.text: **证明。** 每轮只细分、不合并；每次严格改变至少增加一个块，故严格改变次数最多 $|X|-|\mathcal P_0|$。终止时，同块状态到每个商块的转移概率在每个动作下相同，因此闭合成立。若 $\mathcal Q$ 是任一稳定且细化 $\mathcal P_0$ 的分割，归纳假设其细化 $\mathcal P_n$。每个 $\mathcal P_n$ 块是若干 $\mathcal Q$ 块的并；同一 $\mathcal Q$ 块内到这些并集的概率相同，故下一轮也不会将该 $\mathcal Q$ 块拆开。因此 $\mathcal Q$ 细化终止分割，证明最粗性。有限时域结论由核递推。∎

primary.declaration_title_exact: P-ALG-01: correctness and coarseness of finite stable partitioning.
primary.statement_line_exact: **P-ALG-01: correctness and coarseness of finite stable partitioning.** The algorithm terminates in finitely many steps. Its terminal partition is the coarsest controlled-lumpable partition refining $\mathcal P_0$. Its quotient therefore preserves the original outputs, rewards, and one-step distributions for all actions, and by induction the corresponding output laws at every finite horizon.
primary.section_heading_exact: 28.5 The coarsest stable partition algorithm for a known finite model

heading_chain.heading: 28. Complete Interfaces, Algorithms, and Composition Contracts
heading_chain.markdown: # 28. Complete Interfaces, Algorithms, and Composition Contracts

heading_chain.heading: 28.5 The coarsest stable partition algorithm for a known finite model
heading_chain.markdown: ## 28.5 The coarsest stable partition algorithm for a known finite model

proof_markers.text: **Proof.** Iteration only splits blocks, never merges them. Every strict change increases the number of blocks, so there are at most $|X|-|\mathcal P_0|$ strict changes. At termination, states in one block have the same transition probability to every quotient block under every action, establishing closure. Let $\mathcal Q$ be any stable partition refining $\mathcal P_0$, and assume inductively that it refines $\mathcal P_n$. Each $\mathcal P_n$ block is a union of $\mathcal Q$ blocks; states in a common $\mathcal Q$ block have equal transition probabilities to these unions. The next iteration therefore cannot split a $\mathcal Q$ block. Thus $\mathcal Q$ refines the terminal partition, proving coarseness. Finite-horizon preservation follows by kernel recursion. ∎

heading_chain.markdown: ## 37.4 必要且充分的策略存在性

proof_markers.text: **充分性证明。** 使用上一节定义的 $\pi^V$。初始正粗历史满足假设。若时刻 $n$ 的实际正历史满足相应 $V$，策略支持中的唯一动作就是递推选出的共同认证动作。任何实际正后继，按 M-37.1 都对应一个非空的 Succ，因此递推的全称后继条件保证该后继继续满足 $V$。前向归纳覆盖所有实际正历史；在每一步用 M-37.2 得 $\nu_n(C_n^c)=0$。
**必要性证明。** 给右侧策略。对任意实际正历史，它的动作 PMF 至少有一个正质量动作。由 M-37.2，这个动作对所有 $S_n(g)$ 内状态共同认证。对每个非空 Succ，M-37.1 保证对应粗后继有实际正质量，因此可对剩余步数使用归纳假设。得到 $V(n,T-n,S_n(g))$，再应用于初始支持。

heading_chain.heading: 37.4 Necessary and Sufficient Conditions for Policy Existence
heading_chain.markdown: ## 37.4 Necessary and Sufficient Conditions for Policy Existence

proof_markers.text: **Proof of sufficiency.** Use $\pi^V$ from the preceding section. Positive initial coarse histories satisfy the hypothesis. If an actual positive history at time $n$ satisfies the appropriate $V$, the sole action in the policy support is the common certified action chosen by the recursion. By M-37.1, every actual positive successor corresponds to a nonempty Succ; the universal successor clause therefore preserves $V$ there. Forward induction covers all actual positive histories, and M-37.2 gives $\nu_n(C_n^c)=0$ at each step.

**Proof of necessity.** Take a policy as on the right. At any actual positive history, its action PMF has at least one positive-mass action. M-37.2 certifies that action jointly for all states in $S_n(g)$. For every nonempty Succ, M-37.1 gives positive actual mass to the corresponding coarse successor, so the induction hypothesis applies to the remaining steps. This yields $V(n,T-n,S_n(g))$; apply it to the initial supports.
